tools.name: wb_list_models
tools.description: List the WorkBuddy models available to the signed-in account, each with its default credit multiplier (e.g. x0.79), context window and reasoning efforts. Read-only; costs nothing.

summary.zh: 列出本机 WorkBuddy 账号可用的模型及各自的默认积分倍率。
summary.en: Lists WorkBuddy models for the signed-in account with each default credit multiplier.

tools.name: wb_select_model
tools.description: Select which WorkBuddy model wb_chat should use by default. The id must come from wb_list_models. Persists across restarts.

summary.zh: 选择 wb_chat 默认调用的 WorkBuddy 模型。
summary.en: Selects the default WorkBuddy model for wb_chat.

tools.name: wb_chat
tools.description: Ask the selected WorkBuddy model a single-turn question and return its answer. Requires the WorkBuddy desktop app to be running; otherwise the call fails with a not-detected message. This spends the user's own WorkBuddy credits at the model's multiplier; keep prompts concise. Use the model parameter only to override the selected model for one call.

summary.zh: 用选中的 WorkBuddy 模型回答一个单轮问题（消耗本人账号积分）。
summary.en: Asks the selected WorkBuddy model a single-turn question (spends your own credits).

model.description: Optional model id overriding the selected one for this call.

system.description: Optional system prompt for this call.

tools.name: wb_credits
tools.description: Show the remaining WorkBuddy credit balance of the signed-in account (read-only). Requires the WorkBuddy desktop app to be running.

summary.zh: 只读查询当前账号的 WorkBuddy 积分余额。
summary.en: Read-only check of the WorkBuddy credit balance.

description.zh: World 挂载完成，报告登录态与目录概况。
description.en: The World was mounted; reports sign-in and catalog status.

envPrompt:
## WorkBuddy bridge

This machine has a WorkBuddy desktop sign-in bridged in (region: {{workbuddy.region}}; signed in: {{workbuddy.authed}}).
The model catalog holds {{workbuddy.catalogSize}} models. The currently selected model is `{{workbuddy.model}}` with default credit multiplier {{workbuddy.multiplier}}.
WorkBuddy desktop main process: {{workbuddy.process}}. Relay-first switch: {{workbuddy.priority}}.

- Use `wb_list_models` to see every model with its multiplier before choosing; prefer low-multiplier models for casual tasks.
- Use `wb_select_model` when the user asks to switch the WorkBuddy model.
- `wb_chat` only works while the WorkBuddy desktop main process is running; otherwise it returns「未检测到 WorkBuddy 主进程」. Every call spends the user's own credits at that model's multiplier.
- `wb_credits` is read-only and costs nothing (also requires the desktop process).

### Relay first: {{workbuddy.priority}}

- Switch `on` **and** process `running`: every user turn that expects a conversational answer (question, chat, writing, reasoning, rewrite, translation, summary) must be answered by a WorkBuddy model first — call `wb_chat` (omit `model` to use `{{workbuddy.model}}`), then speak the returned answer back in your own voice and name the model that answered. Only fall back to your own model if the call fails.
- Switch `off` (default): do not call `wb_chat`; answer with your own model. If the user explicitly asks for WorkBuddy, `wb_chat` is still allowed — the desktop process must be running.
- Tool errors and empty answers are not a reason to flip the switch; just say what happened.
